# Tiles (`tiles`)

Stat tiles, action tiles, list cards, hero card, icon badge.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createStatTile` (types in `dist/web/data-display/tiles.d.ts`): `.mh-tile.mh-tile--stat`: a reading with `__label`, `__value` (`__number`, `__unit`), `__trend` and `__caption`.

```ts
export function createStatTile(options: StatTileOptions): StatTileHandle;

export interface StatTileOptions {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  unit?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** A line under the value ("Since 07:00"). */
  caption?: string;
  trend?: Trend;
}

export interface StatTileHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setValue(value: string | number): void;
}
```

`createTile` (types in `dist/web/data-display/tiles.d.ts`): `button.mh-tile`: a square-ish action tile with `__icon`, `__label` and `__state`. A toggle tile has `aria-pressed` and, when on, `.is-on` with `--mh-accent-soft`.

```ts
export function createTile(options: TileOptions): TileHandle;

export interface TileOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Icon while on (default: `icon`). */
  iconOn?: IconName | string;
  label: string;
  /** Secondary text: the state or a reading ("On", "80%", "Locked"). */
  state?: string;
  /** Makes the tile a toggle (`aria-pressed`); on tiles use the accent. */
  on?: boolean;
  /** Called with the new state after a toggle tile is pressed. */
  onToggle?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** For non-toggle tiles: what pressing does. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface TileHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setOn(on: boolean): void;
  setState(state: string): void;
}
```

`createTileGrid` (types in `dist/web/data-display/tiles.d.ts`): `.mh-tile-grid`: a responsive grid of tiles; the minimum tile width follows the touch-target size.

```ts
export function createTileGrid(children: Child[], options: { size?: TileGridSize; label?: string } = {}):;
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createStatTile, createTile, createTileGrid } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const light = (label: string, on: boolean): HTMLElement => {
  const tile = createTile({
    icon: 'lightbulb',
    iconOn: 'lightbulb-on',
    label,
    state: on ? 'On' : 'Off',
    on,
    onToggle: (next) => tile.setState(next ? 'On' : 'Off'),
  });
  return tile.el;
};

const temperature = createStatTile({
  label: 'Temperature',
  icon: 'thermometer',
  value: '21.5',
  unit: '°C',
  trend: 'up',
  caption: 'Since 07:00',
});

const grid = createTileGrid([light('Kitchen', true), light('Living room', false), temperature.el], {
  label: 'Living room',
});

document.body.append(grid.el);
```

## React API

`StatTile` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createStatTile`.

```ts
export function StatTile({ label, value, unit, icon, caption, trend, className }: StatTileProps);

export interface StatTileProps {
  label: ReactNode;
  value: ReactNode;
  unit?: ReactNode;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  caption?: ReactNode;
  trend?: Trend;
  className?: string;
}
```

`Tile` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createTile`. Toggle tiles are controlled through `on` and `onToggle`.

```ts
export function Tile({ icon, iconOn, label, state, on, onToggle, onClick, disabled, className }: TileProps);

export interface TileProps {
  icon: IconName | string;
  iconOn?: IconName | string;
  label: ReactNode;
  state?: ReactNode;
  /** Controlled on/off: makes the tile a toggle (`aria-pressed`). */
  on?: boolean;
  onToggle?: (on: boolean) => void;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}
```

`TileGrid` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createTileGrid`.

```ts
export function TileGrid({ size, label, className, children }: TileGridProps);

}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { StatTile, Tile, TileGrid } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function TilesExample() {
  const [lights, setLights] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({ Kitchen: true, 'Living room': false });
  return (
    <TileGrid label="Living room">
      {Object.entries(lights).map(([name, on]) => (
        <Tile
          key={name}
          icon="lightbulb"
          iconOn="lightbulb-on"
          label={name}
          state={on ? 'On' : 'Off'}
          on={on}
          onToggle={(next) => setLights({ ...lights, [name]: next })}
        />
      ))}
      <StatTile
        label="Temperature"
        icon="thermometer"
        value="21.5"
        unit="°C"
        trend="up"
        caption="Since 07:00"
      />
    </TileGrid>
  );
}
```
